candidates.name: OGC API - Connected Systems Standard
verified_facts: OGC API - Connected Systems bridges static system metadata with dynamic observations, events and commands.
The standard supports metadata about systems, deployments, procedures and sampling strategies as well as time-varying data.
semantic_limits: Connected-system metadata or dynamic observations do not automatically represent bare-earth terrain, exact parcel geometry or the survey lineage of the SHA-bound LiDAR DTM.

candidates.name: OGC API - Moving Features Standard
verified_facts: OGC API - Moving Features defines interfaces for querying geospatial data whose position or attributes change over time.
It supports filtering, sorting and aggregation of moving-feature data by location, time and properties.
semantic_limits: Moving-feature trajectories or aggregates must not be substituted for static cadastral parcel geometry or bare-earth elevation measurements.
